title: Glycaemic indices and glycaemic loads of common Korean carbohydrate-rich foods
preparation: Wheat flour and water paste, pan heated on high heat4min using1g oil. Table1 no26, printed418; Table3 no26 printed421. No sugar,egg,kimchi or stuffing reported in this test.
protocol: Healthy men;2 glucose reference visits; venous glucose at0,15,30,60,90,120min. Glucose-hexokinase assay; incremental AUC, below-baseline area excluded; food-level n14. Study calls protocol adapted from FAO/WHO and ISO2010; independent full ISO compliance not established here.
quality: Traceable published original human trial. SUPPLEMENTARY research source: preparation specificity is useful but protocol adaptation, single-sex sample and missing flour/hydration details limit transfer. Not claimed STRONG/ISO-certified.
unresolved: Exact flour refinement,cultivar,brand and flour-water ratio not specified in inspected Table1.
1g oil in experimental serving is not a generic recipe fat level.
SEM9.7 is sampling uncertainty, not a recipeGI range.
Prepared component method is not yet approved.
No inference that added fat or eggs guarantee an equal or lower recipeGI.
